description: This file implements gRPC stream adapters using channels, including server and client stream structures and a function to create pipe streams.

classes.name: chanStream
classes.description: Implements grpc.Stream using channels for message passing.

methods.name: SendHeader
methods.description: Sends header metadata over the channel stream.

methods.name: SetHeader
methods.description: Sets header metadata to be sent.

methods.name: SetTrailer
methods.description: Sets trailer metadata to be sent at the end of the stream.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Receives header metadata from the channel stream.

methods.name: Trailer
methods.description: Receives trailer metadata from the channel stream.

methods.name: CloseSend
methods.description: Closes the send channel of the stream.

methods.name: Context
methods.description: Returns the context associated with the stream.

methods.name: SendMsg
methods.description: Sends a message over the stream.

methods.name: RecvMsg
methods.description: Receives a message from the stream.

methods.name: newPipeStream
methods.description: Creates a new bidirectional pipe stream using channels and manages context cancellation.
